notes.title: Campaign Beta and Inventory service!
notes.content:
Full co-cop Campaign Beta is now live with 6 boss battles and new enemies.

With this update comes new game modes along with the incorporation of tradable steam inventory items. Please report any bugs you may discover.

Thank you,
Trevor.

notes.title: Survival
notes.content:
A new game mode called "Survival" has been added to the latest build. Take on endless waves of AI controlled bots solo or with a group of friends!

Note: This game mode is still in development and will change in later updates to include: perks, bosses and new unlocks!
